fields.v: Criterion stated by the authors: clean replay in a fresh container passes setup + doctor + minimal_verify (per repository); no success threshold on the rate. Generation cost: authors call it 'acceptable', comparable to manual setup. -- (1) BootstrapAgent + own multi-agent pipeline + DeepSeek-V4-Flash-2026-04-25 (temperature 1.0): success 197/212 (92.9%): ExecutionAgent 42/50, Installamatic 38/40, Repo2Run 117/122; median 43.8K tokens, 24.6 min per repository (P90 169.2K, 79.0 min). Quality: no criterion stated by the authors (clean replay is a per-repository success test, no threshold on the success rate; authors only say 'effective for building most repositories'); cost: works per the authors' own statement ('acceptable', comparable to manual setup, one-off). -- (2) HerAgent (baseline; strongest reported baseline, agent/model not stated in this paper; whether re-run under the same verifier not stated): 179/212 (84.4%): 41/50, 34/40, 104/122. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors (unclear whether the clean-replay criterion was applied); cost: not reported. -- (3) Downstream Claude Code (headless, model not stated) cold, without .bootstrap but given the same verification commands (baseline): median wall time 346.3 s overall (ExecutionAgent 285.2 / Installamatic 337.8 / Repo2Run 391.9 s); median active tokens 46.3K (38.9K / 41.6K / 50.8K); total tokens 710.7K (597.9K / 594.4K / 797.8K). Quality: not reported (downstream success not reported); cost: no criterion stated by the authors. -- (4) Downstream Claude Code warm, with .bootstrap: median wall time 249.5 s (112.0 / 282.3 / 309.8 s); median active tokens 36.9K (19.6K / 36.6K / 43.1K); total tokens 419.4K (115.7K / 312.6K / 526.9K). Quality: not reported; cost: no criterion stated by the authors. -- Ablations (Repo2Run / ExecutionAgent / Installamatic success; full 95.9% / 84.0% / 95.0%): (5) w/o repository discovery (ablation) 76.2% / 52.0% / 70.0%; (6) w/o clean replay (ablation) 95.1% / 82.0% / 90.0%; (7) w/o trace-driven repair (ablation) 26.2% / 18.0% / 40.0%; (8) w/o warm-state repair (ablation): +4,839.9 / +851.6 / +421.9 min total time; (9) w/o sanity check (ablation): 5/122, 4/50, 2/40 false positives caught by the full system. Quality and cost for ablations: no criterion stated by the authors
fields.quote: Across 212 repositories, BootstrapAgent improves over HerAgent by 8.5 percentage points, corresponding to a 10.1% relative improvement. This indicates our multi-agent framework is effective for building most repositories.
fields.why: The quality verdict 'works' for BootstrapAgent rests on a per-repository success test and an authors' qualitative claim, while the field itself says there is no success threshold on the rate, so under the protocol rule the verdict should be 'no criterion stated by the authors'.
fields.doubt: O critério 'clean replay' é por repositório; os autores não dão um limiar para a taxa de sucesso (o próprio campo diz isso), só escrevem 'effective for building most repositories' (pág. 6). Pela regra de 2026-11-23, o veredicto de qualidade da configuração (1) seria 'no criterion stated by the authors'. O de custo pode ficar ('acceptable'). Decide.
